Bike parking requirements for areas near

The City’s comprehensive plan supports secure
bike parking at transit sites and bike racks on
buses. All LYNX buses currently have two-bike
racks, but micromobility devices are not allowed.
Allowing micromobility devices on all transit
vehicles is recommended, as well as using buses
with larger-capacity racks where needed. SunRail
permits bikes and micromobility devices and
provides limited bike parking spaces;
coordination is encouraged to increase storage
areas on each train and at each station. See
Section 1.5.1 of Appendix A for more details.

Standards and requirements for bike
parking signage

Suggested language requiring wayfinding signs
for long-term bicycle parking and bicycle parking
within a parking garage has been developed.

Restrictions for parking at informal
locations such as poles or fences

Currently no such restrictions apply, except that a
bike cannot block an accessible route or reduce
the width of an accessible route below the
minimum standard. It is not recommended to
implement a rule that would prevent bicycle
parking at informal locations such as poles or
fences.
